title: Year 2038: Regenerative Asset-Backed Finance & The End of Scarcity Debt

beats.narration:
Entering twenty thirty-eight, global finance faced a paradox no twentieth-century textbook had ever anticipated.
Physical factories, solar-geothermal grids, and autonomous farms were producing unprecedented real wealth—yet legacy debt markets, built on artificial scarcity and compound interest, struggled to price goods whose marginal cost of production had fallen near zero.

beats.actTag: ACT I • ENDOCRINE HOMEOSTASIS: MONEY AS PURE CIRCULATION

beats.narration:
We honor the centuries of bookkeepers, central bankers, and payment engineers who taught humanity double-entry accounting and instant global settlement.
Their disciplined ledgers were the indispensable scaffolding.
In twenty thirty-eight, those ledgers simply graduated from speculative debt compounding to real-world physical accounting.

beats.narration:
Under the new open clearing standard, sovereign and cooperative credit is backed directly by measurable planetary vitality: clean megawatt-hours generated, fertile topsoil humus restored, durable goods crafted, and human skill contributed.
Municipalities fund hundred-year bridges, waterworks, and guildhalls through zero-interest reciprocal credit without inflationary boom-and-bust panic.
